title: Hostinger Tenant Canary evidence publisher reference parity

phases.objective: Replace retired Hostinger-only publisher references with the canonical generic CI Evidence PR Publisher and reject future evidence drift.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Tenant Canary E2E contracts and the canonical CI Evidence PR Publisher
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Every implemented Hostinger contract references existing canonical producer, publisher, routing, and regression evidence, while the retired publisher remains absent.
steps: Load each implemented Hostinger Tenant Canary contract and resolve its evidence paths against the repository tree.
Verify canonical publisher subscription, run-bound artifact download, trusted-main checkout, and bounded Hostinger evidence rendering.
assertions: No contract references the retired Hostinger-only publisher path.
Every declared evidence path exists on the exact candidate head.
The generic publisher consumes Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard artifacts and invokes the bounded Hostinger renderer.
No provider call, credential access, migration apply, deployment, Production mutation, or force push occurs.

phases.objective: Observe the first exact-head Tenant Canary artifact published through the generic publisher after the reference repair.
Extend repository-wide evidence integrity so retired or missing paths are rejected even when their original contract is unchanged.
Verify authoritative Hostinger evidence publication on a qualifying non-production candidate.
This evidence-reference repair grants no deployment, migration, provider, or Production authority.
